question: ______ is the ability of a single cell to produce a fertile, adult individual.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Totipotency**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Totipotency** in this strict sense is **demonstrated **by the **ability **of an **isolated cell **to **produce **a **fertile**, **adult individual**.
 
• Consequently, a totipotent cell** **is also a** one-cell embry**o; that is, a cell that is capable of generating a globally coordinated developmental sequence.
 
• **Totipotent cells **can give** rise to the whole organism** as well as **extraembryonic tissues such as the placenta**.
 
• **Spores and zygotes** are examples of totipotent cells.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pluripotency** describes the ability of a **cell to develop into the three primary germ cell layers** of the early embryo and therefore into all cells of the adult body, but** not extra-embryonic tissues** such as the **placenta**. 

 
 
• Pluripotent cells** can give rise to the whole organism** but** not the extraembryonic tissue**.
 
• **Examples **of pluripotent cells are** stem cells** in animals and meristematic cells in higher plants. 
 
 
 
• A** Mutation occurs **when a **DNA gene is damaged** or **changed **in such a way as to** alter the genetic message** carried by that gene.
 
 
• A Mutagen is an agent of substance that can bring about a permanent alteration to the physical composition of a DNA gene such that the genetic message is changed.
 
• Once the gene has been damaged or changed the mRNA transcribed from that gene will now carry an altered message.
 
 
 
• **Cloning** is the process of generating a genetically identical copy of a cell or an organism.
